The vendor directly providing **ProductionCrate** at **productioncrate.com** is **ProductionCrate Studios LLC** (successor-in-interest to **ProductionCrate LLC**).

### Evidence
* According to the **ProductionCrate Studios LLC Terms of Use and Limited License Agreement** on `productioncrate.com`:
  > *"These terms of use (hereinafter “Terms of Use”) govern your access to and use of the www.ProductionCrate.com website and the other websites formerly operated by ProductionCrate LLC and now operated by ProductionCrate Studios LLC... You acknowledge and agree that ProductionCrate Studios LLC is the successor-in-interest to ProductionCrate LLC..."*
* The platform's Privacy Policy also confirms:
  > *"By use of the www.ProductionCrate.com website, which is owned and operated by ProductionCrate LLC..."*
